title: GulagSMP
description: A lifesteal pvp server, with economy, fun events, and more!
body:
### Welcome to GulagSMP! 
This is a lifesteal PvP-focused server. Griefing, stealing from, and raiding bases is a part of the fun!
Protect your items, team up with friends, and participate in other fun events and duels with other players on the server!

Both Java and Bedrock can join.

### Bedrock: 
gulagsmp.net
Port: 19132

Or you can add GLSMP as a friend and join their world!

### Events:

Join King of the Hill or FFA events to compete agianst other players on the server and win prizes!

### Duels:
Duel other players with kits, wager money on the fights, or even fight for your inventory!
